title: It does not work!
text: It does not work!. This vacuum does not look like the product picture at all. It's such a cheaply made vacuum, but the seller charges very high. It does not pick up dirt. I just got a short fur puppy, it this vacuum has a really hard time pick up anything! Such a big disappointment!

product_metadata.title: HUKEY Handheld Vacuum, 8KPA Wet & Dry Cordless Hand Vac with Detachable Battery Storage Dock and HEPA Filter Lightweight Vacuum for Car and Home (Grey)
features: 【8000Pa STRONG SUCTION & 100W HIGH POWER】Advanced cyclone technology, 100W high power motor provides up to 8Kpa powerful suction. Easily pick up cat litter, dog food, cookie crumbs, and even invisible dust as small as 0.1μm, which beats most of hand held vacuum on Amazon, lets you experience stronger suction.

【DETACHABLE BATTERY & 2200mAh LARGE CAPACITY】2020 latest REMOVABLE battery design. You can charge the battery by removing it from the vacuum cleaner, which makes charging more worry-free. Outstanding 2200mAh battery provide a LONG WORKING TIME, large capacity battery ensures thorough cleaning the house or the car. Just fully charged in 4-5 hours and configure a dedicated adapter and running time last 20mins.

【DRY & WET AMPHIBIOUS】HUKEY UPGRADED cordless hand vacuum equipped with WATER NOZZLE, easily pick up large particles of trash and also for liquid handling, such as water, coffee, milk, etc. Makes cleaning easier and fast, no more worry about liquid spill.

【STORAGE BASE & MINI BODY】NEWEST DESIGN. Tailor-made STORAGE DOCK makes storage easier, solve the problem of vacuum cleaners nowhere to be stored. High configuration beats most hand vacuum. MINI and LIGHT body makes carrying and storage more easier, volume and weight are only two-thirds of other vacuum, makes cleaning easier and saves space.
description: How to Ensure Handheld Cordless Vacuum Good Suction?

1: Every time after using the machine, empty the trash in the dust cup in time.2: While emptying the trash, please clean your HEPA.3: Note: HEPA must be cleaned frequently, this will ensure that your machine has better suction power.
